law_name: Law No. 8 of 25 January 1991 on copyright (amended by Laws No. 63/1997 and 43/1998)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 36; photographs life + 50 years; computer programs 50 years from first disclosure; terms run to end of calendar year)
enforcement_body: State Patent and Trademark Office (Ufficio di Stato Brevetti e Marchi) - proposed copyright role only, unconfirmed (unconfirmed)
notes: Berne, WCT, WPPT in force 2 Sep 2020 (Council Decrees 69-71). WIPO Lex notes no consolidated text; a copyright reform bill was requested in Jan 2025, status unknown. Term from Commons summary; a Generis explainer says 70 years (not relied on).
